question: 'Unbreakable' is an autobiography of _______________ published in 2013.
solution:
The correct answer is __**MC Mary Kom**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **MC Mary Kom** is an Indian Olympic boxer and a six-time world champion in boxing.
 
• Her autobiography, titled "**Unbreakable**", was published in **2013**.
 
• Mary Kom is also known as "**Magnificent Mary**" for her outstanding achievements in the sport.
 
• She has been awarded the **Padma Bhushan**, **Padma Shri**, and **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna** for her contributions to Indian sports.
 
• Mary Kom's story is one of resilience and determination, inspiring many young athletes across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Boxing**: A combat sport in which two people throw punches at each other for a predetermined amount of time in a boxing ring.
 
• **Olympic Boxing**: Boxing has been a part of the Olympic Games since 1904, with women’s boxing introduced in the 2012 London Olympics.
 
• **AIBA World Boxing Championships**: An annual boxing competition organized by the International Boxing Association (AIBA), where Mary Kom has won six gold medals.
 
• **Padma Awards**: Among the highest civilian awards in India, recognizing achievements in various fields including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna**: The highest sporting honor of the Republic of India, awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to recognize outstanding achievements in sports.
